title: Oxchibus
description: ‘Oxford Chinese Businesses’ or ‘OXCHIBUS’ is a website dedicated to recording the history of the Chinese community in Oxfordshire, England. OXCHIBUS aims to record the history of Chinese owned businesses in Oxford between the year 1910 and 1990’s.

title: Pokedex
description: A recreation of the Pokemon Brilliant Diamond pokedex. Utilises custom made SVGs for certain assets for the scrollbar, background etc. The application uses the PokeApi to gather data for the pokedex.

title: CS50x Final Project
description: The CS50 marketplace is my final project for CS50x. It is a simple e-commerce store for secondhand or homemade products. This is a fullstack application using Vue and Flask
